BiblicalUsage: This is the word for a skin, and it stands in the roll call of faith where men and women wandered in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute and tormented. The skin was the clothing of prophets who had nothing else.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sheepskin in Hebrews is the uniform of the faithful poor; the world called them unworthy, but God counted them as His own, and their suffering is written down as faith.
